# Epic: User Management System

## Overview
Implement a comprehensive user management system that handles both service providers (businesses) and their customers, following SOLID principles and ensuring high testability.

## Objectives
- Create secure authentication system
- Implement role-based access control
- Manage business and customer profiles
- Handle user preferences and settings

## Features
1. [Business Account Management](../../features/user-management/01-business-account.md)
2. [Customer Account Management](../../features/user-management/02-customer-account.md)
3. [Authentication System](../../features/user-management/03-authentication.md)
4. [Role and Permission Management](../../features/user-management/04-roles-permissions.md)

## Technical Requirements
- Implement using Ruby on Rails authentication best practices
- Follow SOLID principles for class design
- Minimum 95% unit test coverage
- Implementation of proper password hashing and security measures
- API endpoints for all user operations

## Acceptance Criteria
- Users can register and authenticate securely
- Business owners can manage their business profile
- Customers can create and manage their profiles
- Role-based access control properly restricts access
- Password reset and email verification workflows function correctly

## Dependencies
- None (Foundation Epic)

## Estimate
- Story Points: 34
- Timeline: 3 weeks
